summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce a regular quarterly dividend of $0.23 per share, payable on July 10, 2026 to holders of record June 26, 2026. This is a routine capital-allocation action with no special-situation transaction (merger, tender, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.). The filing lacks any extraordinary structural features or events that would warrant classification beyond an ordinary dividend declaration. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are present. The filing is non-transformational and purely operational.
